description: The Cosmo Bowl Shot is a high-quality handcrafted hookah bowl from Russia, designed for efficient heat management and enhanced smoking sessions. Made from premium clay and fired at approximately 1100°C, this bowl offers durability, excellent heat retention, and optimal flavor preservation. Key Features: Material: High-quality Russian clay, capable of withstanding high temperatures. Design: Multi-hole (Turkish-style) design promotes intense smoke production and efficient airflow. Tobacco Capacity: Holds around 10-14 grams of tobacco, making it ideal for medium-length smoking sessions. Compatibility: Works with both heat management devices (HMDs) like Kaloud Lotus and traditional foil setups.
Nash Raspberry – rich sugar raspberry, with a pleasant sourness. Moderately sweet and overly tasty. It feels like you are popping a real raspberry! Great for solo smokes as well as mixes.

Nash Strawberry – juicy taste of bright, ripe strawberries freshly plucked from a sprig. It is moderately sour, moderately sweet and incredibly tasty! It is comfortable to smoke, both in solo and in mixes!

Nash Bird Cherry – one of the top ! Bright, moderately sour and sweet taste of bird cherry berries. In principle, this is a rather rare taste, and in this case it is very coolly rendered! We advise you to try it solo first to hear all its cool notes, and then mix it up.

Nash Groot – There aren’t many decent pine flavors on the market, but this one is definitely one to try! Intense aroma of bark, after a rain in the forest with a pleasant aftertaste of juniper. Solo or mix – it’s up to you, he will be pretty good both there and there! Why? Because Groot is too cool!
Nash Rondo – very cool taste of natural Rondo sweets! Refreshing motifs are perfect for any clogging, so the flight of your imagination can literally know no bounds!

Nash Lychee – the unusual taste of an exotic and very interesting lychee fruit-berry, which is somewhat similar to lychee. Not too bright, but nice sweet and sour. Great for driving in mixes to add an interesting tropical twist.
Nash Papaya – juicy and at the same time slightly creamy taste of exotic papaya fruit. With prevailing sweet notes of ripe fruit.

Nash Pineapple – delicious and juicy, like most of the flavors of the NASH brand, ripe pineapple right in your bowl! He is so cool that you can safely score him in solo. And for tropical mixes, an indispensable ingredient! Take it for a try and enjoy.
Nash Mango – Do you want to experience Thailand right now? This taste perfectly conveys all the sweet, grassy and slightly sour notes of a natural fruit and envelops with its tropical motives!
Nash Dragon Fruit – sweet, tart and rich taste of pitahaya – it is also a dragon fruit that came to us from Asia. Delicious, interesting and great for mixes!

Nash Guanabana – juicy moderately sour and grassy taste of an exotic fruit that few people know, but thanks to this taste – there is an opportunity to find out! Pleasant for solo smokes, as well as add interesting notes to mixes.

Nash Waffle – lovers of dessert flavors – this thing is especially for you! Disgracefully cool sweet waffles, with a pleasant vanilla aftertaste and milky notes. It smokes very comfortably and pleasantly.
Nash Peanut Butter – sweet and juicy peanut butter flavor that is so versatile that it can be soloed and enjoyed with sweet notes, as well as mixed to add a nice and unique touch to your shot!
Nash ButterScotch – flavor that is perfect for dessert mixes. In solo, they resemble sweet toffee candies “Kis-Kis”. Very interesting and original taste!

Nash Bakery – Do you like oriental sweets? Then rather take this taste and fill yourself in a cup! Sweet puff pastry base, with pleasant delicate notes of rose petals and incredible sugar zest! Oh, how delicious it is in solo!

Nash Grapefruit – citrus wave is coming! This is a cool rich taste of grapefruit pulp with a pleasant and unobtrusive bitterness characteristic of grapes! For lovers of citrus, you can score solo, and for not so bright fans – mix. Either way, the taste will be fine

Nash Lemon – the long-awaited and unusual taste of a really sour lemon. It will be interesting to smoke solo, and can also be a great addition as a sourness to your mix. This taste should definitely be in your collection, as there are very few really good sour flavors.
Nash Mandarin – rich sweet and sour taste of ripe mandarin. Interesting and sweeter than an orange in its natural form. Pleasant citrus notes will perfectly brighten up almost any mix.
Nash Pomergranate – tart, rich, very cool pomegranate. A taste that vividly conveys the natural notes of pomegranate pulp. It smokes quite comfortably in solo, and will be a great addition to mixes!

Nash Banan – sweet and at the same time delicate taste of banana pulp. This fragrance is perfect for creating interesting mixes. And if you are an ardent fan of this taste in general, then you can try it solo.

Nash Indigo – it would seem – blueberries, raspberries and elderberries. How simple. But what is the mysterious indigo flower? After all, it was he who brought this combination to perfection, while retaining his secret. You don’t have to be indigo to feel it. Just try!
Nash Grape/Mint – it’s not just a taste – it’s a tribute to tradition. The same taste of sweet ripe grapes combined with mint, only much better;) It will help you remember where we all started.
Nash Lipton – the taste of fresh green tea, pleasant and refreshing. Somewhere even remind the taste of a well-known drink. It’s great for solos and works just as well in mixes.

Nash May Tai – light cocktail with pineapple juice, lime and almond aftertaste. It is quite unusual, very attractive and most importantly – delicious! We advise you to try it solo for the first time, so that later you knead in mixes clearly and juicy!
Nash Halls – a taste that from the first notes will remind you of the popular and classy Halls lemon candies with a refreshing aftertaste.

Nash Skittles – a taste from the mixological line – do you remember what the legendary and popular Skittles sweets taste like? This is exactly how it is here! Sweet and sour taste, not oversaturated and quite versatile.
Nash Last Samurai – the taste from the mixological line is sweet, with floral and berry notes of vanilla and jasmine. Very soft, light and tasty.

Nash Oasis – The best citrus-tropical combination you can find on the market! Not chemo. All ingredients are perfectly balanced and complement each other. It’s hard to say what exactly is here, but pleasant notes of mango and citrus fruits definitely make their way through.

Nash Berry’s – taste from the mixological line – bright notes of juicy white grapes are perfectly intertwined with the sweetness of freshly picked mulberries. An interesting and unambiguously noteworthy combination.

Nash White Strawberry – the only flavor on the market that boasts incredible notes!! This is a definite TOP among all tastes! It intertwines bright juicy, sweet strawberry motifs, with interesting sour notes that resemble pineapple. Perhaps it is this combination that is unrealistically cool!

Nash Basilic/Lime – taste released in collaboration with hookah blogger Dava Dim – an interesting grassy taste in which notes of sour lime and basil are perfectly intertwined, with a sweet aftertaste.
Nash Lavender/Feijoa – taste released in collaboration with hookah blogger Dava Dim – a top combination of grassy and slightly sour feijoa with sweet notes of lavender!

Nash Passion Fruit/Avocado – taste released in collaboration with hookah blogger Dava Dym – this flavor combines cool sour notes of ripe passion fruit and healthy fat avocado. How did the guys achieve the taste of avocado, given that it itself is tasteless, but it turned out very tasty!

After 8 True delight for those who enjoy the combination of chocolate with mint. From the very first inhale, you are enveloped in a wave of the most delicate chocolate aroma, which melts pleasantly in your mouth. It is perfectly balanced with the refreshing flavor of cool mint.

Almond Icecream Amazing taste of almond ice cream. The slightly bitter aroma of fresh almonds combined with refreshing creamy sweetness. A rich, delicate, and spicy blend that produces lots of smoke and lasts a long time.

Apple Shock Have you been searching for the perfect apple? Perhaps you’ll find it in the Apple Shock tobacco by Blackburn. This is a true sour green apple with no additives. The aroma is very vibrant, rich, and “juicy”. Combined with its good strength, this tobacco can take a proud place among your favorite flavors. We highly recommend it!

Asian Lychee An absolutely unique and intriguing flavor of exotic lychee. The sweet fruity aroma will captivate you, and its vibrant aftertaste will transport you to the atmosphere of a tropical getaway, adding variety and joy to any evening.

Barberry Shock We are used to the fact that if barberry is mentioned, it often turns out to be sweet candies, but not this time. Barberry Shock changes the usual state of affairs and offers a very sour aroma. The taste is incredibly vibrant, and when smoked solo, it will make even the most avid fans of sour flavors pucker their cheeks.

Black Honey A rich and robust taste of honey and wildflowers. You won’t find a better tobacco with a honey flavor – the deep aroma of meadow flowers combined with sticky-sweet honey is perfect for smoking during the cold seasons.

Brownie When a dessert contains no extra calories, only the impeccable taste of a tender chocolate sponge cake. Notes of your favorite treat with a slight bitterness and appetizing sweet undertones will bring plenty of smoky delight.

Cherry Shock Cherry Shock is an intense flavor of sour cherry, tangy and aromatic. If you’re looking for a cherry aroma that closely resembles the natural fruit, Cherry Shock might be the perfect choice for you. This excellent sour cherry flavor, combined with the strong strength of BlackBurn tobacco, definitely deserves your attention and has the potential to become your favorite among berry flavors.

Grape lollipop This BlackBurn soda will definitely quench any thirst. The grape flavor is quite complex to replicate, so there is often some skepticism about it. However, this soda pleasantly surprises. The aroma is “alive,” as if it were a natural fruit. The taste resembles grape juice – rich, with a slightly tangy note, and there is also a hint of something honey soda-like in the background. It works great when smoked solo. The taste is prominent and generously accompanies the entire smoking process. There is no doubt for a moment that the bowl is filled with a non-cloying, sweet-tangy grape juice. The blend proves to be heat-resistant and, if overheated, it recuperates relatively quickly. It is also stronger in strength than average. Overall, it is juicy and probably one of the longest-lasting flavors.

Cranberry Shock The shock therapy from Burn continues with the madness of sour cranberry. The signature berry tartness comes through, primarily in the aftertaste. Escaping intense emotions is impossible! This flavor is for those who want to wake up and ignite their senses. The bright tartness of cranberry fully reveals itself. The strong Burley tobacco base smokes in the background, creating thick clouds in the best Burn traditions. The leaf has a substantial strength, allowing for experimentation with packing methods and bowls while enjoying the experience. It is highly heat-resistant, and the taste easily recovers from overheating (unlike recovering from COVID), leaving you with a sense of pure relaxation.

Crème Brûlée The highlight of the dessert Crème Brûlée is its caramelized crispy crust. It is this flavor with notes of creamy, buttery dessert base that we have captured in the taste of BlackBurn Crème Brûlée. The original dessert recipe definitely includes vanilla, and if you are a connoisseur of hookah tobacco, you will also surely discover the taste of vanilla in BlackBurn Crème.

Elderberry Shock The zestfully tart aroma of the unique elderberry berries with a bitter but sweet undertone. It shocks the taste receptors even more than the legendary Shock candies from the wild 90s.

Famous Apple A versatile flavor that is suitable for any mix or for smoking solo. It feels like strolling through an apple orchard at dawn, when the morning chill has not yet dissipated. Slightly sweet with a characteristic tartness, the apple taste is instantly recognizable from the first inhale.

Garnet Garnet will satisfy any connoisseur. Its pleasant, exotic, and moderately tart taste of pomegranate is perfect for any fruity hookah mixes and also smokes well solo. With a pleasant bitter note and a rich fruity aftertaste, it energizes and the unique taste is definitely worth trying for all sour lovers.

Green Tea The soft aroma of BlackBurn tobacco – Green Tea will immerse you in a relaxing atmosphere. The pleasant, velvety taste of green tea is alluringly aromatic, and the tobacco smokes smoothly, leaving a pleasant aftertaste. It is perfect for energizing and pairs well with pastries as well as mixes with lime, raspberry, basil, and apple.

BLACKBURN feat. GUF – ICE BABY The first collaboration flavor in the history of the hookah industry with the artist – Berry Sorbet with Fresh Grapefruit. The vibrant taste of forest berries and the enchanting aroma of grapefruit create a light summery mood, while the coolness pleasantly relaxes after a long day. Moderately sweet, moderately tangy, and moderately fresh. The inhale brings pleasant sweetness, while the exhale has a gentle tanginess. If you’re tired of overly sweet flavors and want something natural and easy-going, ICE BABY is perfect for you. Its rich and balanced taste unfolds beautifully when smoked solo. The flavor is based on dark leaf Burley tobacco, with a medium cut and optimal syrupiness. It is resistant to overheating and quickly recovers. Thanks to high-temperature processing, the tobacco acquires a soft, balanced taste.
Haribon The taste of sweet gummy candies with the fizzy flavor of cola. It smokes great on its own, and in mixes, you can add orange, lemon, or alcoholic flavors.

Something Berry Do you love something berry-flavored? Then choose Something Berry – a rich, tangy-sweet aroma of juicy berries with hints of bitterness, floral notes, and herbal undertones. You can catch the intense notes of blueberries, blackberries, raspberries, gooseberries, hawthorn, red and black currants. It is perfect on its own, but also blends well with minty, tea, dessert, and fruity flavors.

Something Icy – Have you seen the movie “The Day After Tomorrow”? Remember the moment when the air current instantly froze everything in its path: helicopters, buildings … like Something Icy from BlackBurn. Powerful, assertive, icy, uncompromising!

Something Sweet – The literal translation of the taste – “Something sweet” describes this BlackBurn tobacco quite accurately. You will truly enjoy the aroma of the very sweet feijoa jam. If you like sweet or even dessert flavors, be sure to try Something Sweet.

Something Tropical Try the powerful and stunning mix of tropical fruits in BlackBurn tobacco – Something Tropical. Enjoy the vibrant and multi-faceted bouquet with dominant notes of pineapple, mango, dragonfruit, passionfruit, starfruit, longan, mangosteen, and lime. It has an excellent tangy-sweet aroma with light bitter, floral, and herbal undertones.

Sou-Sep A refreshing sip of cool tarragon stirs up childhood memories with its herbaceous aroma that perfectly blends with creamy notes of tropical soursop: an exotic sugar apple, with its delightful tangy-sweet aftertaste.
Strawberry Coconut A vitamin-packed boost from a refreshing mix of ripe strawberries and exotic coconut, seasoned with a cool and tangy aroma of eucalyptus.

Strawberry Jam BlackBurn Strawberry Jam with the taste of strawberry jam, perfect for lovers of berry classics. It has a pleasant, light aroma and a very sweet taste with hints of berry undertones. The jam flavor adds even more richness without being overly sweet. Try combining it with blueberries, cranberries, and a touch of mint or coolness to create your own berry medley.
Sundaysun A vibrant, fresh, and aromatic summer cocktail made from citrus fruits – lemon, orange, and grapefruit. One of the best citrus blends!

Irish Cream The taste of Irish cream with a high strength and a variety of flavor sensations. Connoisseurs of unparalleled flavors will appreciate the taste of Irish whiskey with the aroma of delicate cream. And the chocolate aftertaste on the finish will bring much pleasure.

product_name: Black Burn It’s Not Black Currant – 100g
description: It’s not black currant Red currant by Burn won’t let you get bored today. The berry nuances will bring a smile to the faces of those who spent summers in the countryside or at their dacha. Tangy notes without spiciness, but with a gentle sweetness – it’s like riding an American flavor roller coaster with lots of smoke. The intensity of the berry flavor is achieved with natural flavorings (even grandma won’t be able to tell the difference). The dark and finest Burley adds strength, with its smooth character winning over many hearts. It is suitable for those who have long been immersed in the hookah scene. The flavor transmission will start according to schedule, right after a fresh pack. During breaks, there will be thick fog and increased relaxation.

Kiwi Stoner An interesting and even intriguing sour-sweet taste. It refreshes and uplifts the mood. An excellent choice for a hot day to give you a little boost and switch gears. It tastes fantastic when smoked solo, with even sweet notes on the finish. Overall, it’s explosively sour. If you add some cooling and mint, it becomes a truly spectacular mix. BlackBurn, based on Burley leaves, is quite strong, but you can “lighten the mood” with a denser pack. The cut is excellent, medium, and the syrupiness is optimal. The taste and aroma are evident from the first inhale.

Lemon Shock Lemon, a true LEMON. No candy stories, no lollipops, and all that! Only a sour taste, only hardcore. Lemon SHOCK is a versatile flavor that is great for mixing and performs exceptionally well solo.

Lemon Sweets An unexpected twist on the classic lemon flavor – a delicate sweet lemon with citrus undertones. On the exhale, a hint of lemon candy lingers in the mouth. The tanginess in this tobacco is not overpowering, making it appealing to those who enjoy light and slightly sweet tastes. It is pleasant to smoke on its own and blends well with various fruity, tea, and dessert-themed mixes. It can also create an unexpected flavor palette, for example, in a pairing with “Strawberry Jam.”

Malibu Strawberry islands in a sea of cream – that’s Malibu by BlackBurn. Sweet, creamy, and strawberry delight envelops you with every inhale of Malibu. We all know this flavor thanks to the red and white Malibu candies, and now you can easily experience it by packing a bowl of BlackBurn Malibu.

Melon Halls The signature flavor of double-impact candies: freshness and the enjoyment of aromatic Melon! Melon Halls is a new flavor in the strong lineup of BlackBurn, which performs excellently both solo and in various mixes. Melon Halls is juicy, smoky, and strong! Be the first to try it!

Over D Explosive hit of 2021 – a strong and juicy flavor combining the tangy notes of juicy lemon and bold lime! Perfect for creating fantastic citrus mixes. Caution! High strength 10/10 Preheat with 4x 25mm charcoal for 5-6 minutes (the product has increased heat resistance) The strength of the product unfolds throughout the entire session, not just in the first few minutes, allowing for comfortable enjoyment of the process and maximum relaxation.

Sweet papaya One of the four flavors released in collaboration with the renowned hookah blogger Slava KMТM (Your Mom’s Hookah Master). It is a juicy and herbal flavor of papaya with subtle creamy notes and a hint of tanginess.

Peach Killer Luxurious and rich flavor of sweet and tender peach flesh. Bright and pleasant aftertaste accompanied by aromatic smoke. Peach Killer pairs perfectly with almost all other fruity flavors.

Peachberry Dark Burn once again brings winning combinations. This time, the unmatched aromatic forest strawberry is complemented by the daring spiciness of a sun-kissed peach’s delicate juiciness. The duo is nothing short of “Wow!” – perfect for any occasion and mood. It boosts energy and sets the tone for a warm, smoke-filled atmosphere. To relax, the select dark Burley adds its strength, giving the chill the desired flair and a fiery sound. The tobacco performs well with different packing methods, offering possibilities for experimentation and appealing to those who appreciate a stronger hookah experience.
Pear Lemonade Flawless blend of pear, ice, and mint. A wonderful bright summer flavor for hot evenings, perfect for those who prefer something refreshing.
Pinacolada A vibrant, sunny taste of the classic Caribbean cocktail expertly crafted from the rich flavors of fresh pineapple juice and smooth coconut milk that melts in your mouth.

Pistachio icecream Pistachio ice cream – just what you need for summer! Pistachio Ice Snow is amazingly cold, yet at the same time, it has a very delicate nutty-creamy taste, based on a Toasted Burley tobacco leaf. Pistachio Ice Snow is the magic of the strong BlackBurn, which gives you goosebumps! Hurry up and give it a try!

Raspberry Sweet, aromatic raspberry with a pleasant hint of tartness on the finish. It smokes very smoothly and pleasantly on its own. After smoking, it leaves a gentle aftertaste, and its sweet, fresh aroma will be enjoyed not only by the smoker but also by those around.

Real P.F. The unreal tropical flavor will remind you of the forgotten shades of a sun-kissed seaside. The vibrant taste of passionfruit, with its charismatic spicy sweetness and tanginess, will transport you straight to the smoky clouds of pleasure. Bright, authentic – not like the travels of 2020. It’s a colorful fireworks display on the map of everyday life! The rich notes are complemented by the dark Burley tobacco leaf, bringing the necessary level of relaxation to tired people and dull evenings. The elevated strength of the tobacco doesn’t give itself away in the flavor, smoothly melting in soft clouds of smoke. The tobacco can handle any flavor transitions, mixes well with other flavors, has moderate syrupiness, and retains the intensity of aroma and smoke for a long time. It is undemanding when it comes to packing.
Red Orange The flavor of exotic red orange. It is tangy yet sweet, incredibly aromatic and rich.

Rising Star A mix for lovers of sweetness and tropical flavors, like an aromatic cocktail carefully crafted for you on a sandy beach by the ocean or at an evening bar by the poolside. The sweet notes of mango combined with the aroma of passionfruit certainly set this flavor apart from the rest of the fruity lineup from BlackBurn.

Shock, currant shock This flavor is definitely for blackcurrant lovers. As soon as you open the package, the tangy and spicy aroma of blackcurrant fills the room, as if freshly picked blackcurrants are right there on the table. During inhalation, it delivers a pleasant sour taste with pronounced blackcurrant notes. It provides the right level of acidity and refreshment. The taste lingers for a long time, without becoming tiresome, though you can experiment and mix in some sweet accents if desired. The flavor is multi-faceted and interesting due to the tanginess and spiciness, and it doesn’t have a soapy taste. The herbal undertones create a “forest mood.” The blend is rich and strong, based on the dark Burley tobacco variety, which provides a faster effect compared to Virginia and is more suitable for those who are already familiar with hookah smoking. It has optimal heat resistance, is not afraid of overheating, quickly recovers, and delivers great flavor transmission.

Blue Grapefruit The triumphant return of the iconic Blue Grapefruit flavor in a modern rendition. The vibrant berry aroma of strawberry and blueberry gently intertwines with citrus notes of grapefruit, creating the legendary “blue mist”.

Tropical Rose An elegant combination of ripe tropical fruits with the intoxicating aroma of rose petals that will not leave any girl indifferent. After all, each one will somehow receive her coveted flower.

Sexy A gastronomic orgasm of juicy grapefruit, fragrant strawberries, and fresh raspberries, just for you and for her. A sensual explosion that dissolves the bitter citrus into the shades of ripe berries.

Watermelon or Melon The classic summer mix of juicy watermelon flesh, perfectly paired with sweet and sugary cantaloupe, will refresh you even in the hottest weather. A light and playful mood is guaranteed for a long time!
